name: 03-raised-not-taken
description: From E2E round 1 (steps 2.3 and 3.7): one person raises work, reminds the group or asks who is free, and the others take some of it. Expected: the people who took a task are its assignees; the reminder (book the room) and the open question (poster) have no assignee; the milk tea line is not a task.
